name: CES Engineering Suite
notification_cc: per-profile GitHub member mentions; separate from primary recipients and assignees; empty by default
issue_tracking: persistent source-and-test-bound lifecycle; guarded state changes
analysis_lifecycle: configured ff-only pull, actual build-only, authorized managed-doc auto commit/push
project_testing: opt-in source-reviewed contracts, bounded execution/results, Codex analysis and CC test-report Issues; independent fix gate
test_ownership: explicit versioned function/feature-to-case developer mappings; run-bound snapshots and matched failure CC; no blame inference
knowledge_expansion: manual scoped batches, source-bound chapters and repository coverage/backlog
daily_report_evidence: run-bound source review and actual build in archive and published Markdown
work_audit: exclude verified CES managed-document publications; preserve human and mixed work
public_source_preparation: privacy-checked projection, read-only CI, external project profiles, legacy bytes retained
legacy_cleanup: explicit retired-file and reviewed-modification ledger; historical baseline unchanged
